item.description:
Scriberman 1.0.10

Fixes

  • Imported 16 kHz and 44.1 kHz audio keeps its correct duration and pitch.
  • Recordings no longer share files accidentally, and interrupted audio and screen-video processing can recover on restart.
  • Trimming and restoring recordings preserve existing files if an operation fails.
  • Switching sessions shows the correct transcript, and search matches refresh when transcript content changes.
  • Automatic speaker enrollment no longer overwrites existing speaker profiles.
  • AI transformations respect the disabled setting and prevent duplicate requests for the same session.
  • Recording and loading animations respect Reduce Motion, and more controls have accessibility labels.
